The knowledge base did **not** return Raw-file citations for this query; it returned vault/wiki evidence summaries. So I can’t present this as a fully Raw-cited answer. Based on the returned current vault evidence, the strongest opportunities appear to be:

| Rank | Opportunity | Best-fit tester | Why it looks strong | Vault evidence returned |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Wi‑Fi 7 chipset / module R&D and production test** | **CMX500 for signaling R&D; CMP180 for non-signaling production** | Clear two-stage semiconductor workflow: validate new Wi‑Fi 7 features in signaling mode during R&D, then move to high-throughput non-signaling RF production test. | Vault summary says CMX500 is positioned as a multi-technology, multi-channel signaling tester with integrated Wi‑Fi 7 test functionality for testing cellular and non-cellular standards in one setup. Wi‑Fi 7 R&D coverage includes signaling-mode RF TX/RX, MLO, multiple RF chains, 2x2 MIMO, 6 GHz out-of-band discovery, coexistence, and E2E tests. CMP180 is positioned for WLAN device production where RF measurements are run in non-signaling mode to save time, supporting Wi‑Fi 6E, Wi‑Fi 7 and 5G NR FR1 up to 8 GHz, bandwidths up to 500 MHz. Sources returned: “Wi‑Fi 7 R&D and production testing”; “Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi‑Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024.” |
| 2 | **Next-gen Wi‑Fi / Wi‑Fi 8 early silicon validation** | **CMP180, plus CMX500 if signaling support is needed later** | Early silicon and PHY/RF teams need margin/headroom before standards are finalized. CMP180 evidence around 480 MHz WLAN waveform and 500 MHz bandwidth makes it a strong exploratory/advanced PHY opportunity. | Vault summary says CMP180 can demonstrate loopback verification of a **480 MHz WLAN waveform**, described as a potential candidate for yet-to-be-defined Wi‑Fi 8 / IEEE 802.11bn, while noting this is not a formal Wi‑Fi 8 specification. CMP180 has two analyzers, two generators and two sets of eight RF ports for single-box 2x2 MIMO, and two units can be combined for 4x4 MIMO access point testing. Source returned: “Wi‑Fi 7 R&D and production testing.” |
| 3 | **5G NR modem / RF transceiver validation across FR1, FR2, NSA/SA** | **CMX500 signaling tester** | This is the core semiconductor modem/chipset opportunity: network emulation, signaling, TX measurements, throughput, BLER, fading, and pre-conformance-style workflows. | Vault summary says CMX500 is a universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution for latest 3GPP 5G NR device testing, covering LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD and TDD. Returned feature evidence includes NR FR1/FR2 signaling and TX measurements, fading, AWGN, BLER, CSI report, throughput, PER, application test, IP traffic analysis, IMS/audio/POLQA, XLAPI and SCPI automation. Source returned: “R&S CMX500.” |
| 4 | **RedCap / eRedCap chipset and IoT module validation** | **CMX500** | RedCap/eRedCap are semiconductor-driven opportunities because they target lower-cost, lower-complexity cellular chipsets/modules for IoT, wearables, industrial and embedded devices. | Vault summary lists CMX500 signaling options for **NR Rel. 17 RedCap** and **Rel. 18 eRedCap**. A CMX500 Callbox use-case summary also lists RedCap among example callbox use cases, along with sensitivity testing, pre-conformance, UL MIMO/UL CA RF measurements and non-signaling verification. Sources returned: “R&S CMX500”; “CMX500 Callbox.” |
| 5 | **NTN / Direct-to-Cell chipset and device validation** | **CMX500** | Strong emerging semiconductor opportunity for satellite-capable modems, NB‑NTN/NR‑NTN chipsets, D2C phones/modules, and long-duration mobility/handover validation. | Vault summary says CMX500 has NTN signaling extensions for Rel. 17, Rel. 18 and Rel. 19, plus NB‑NTN signaling. Another returned summary says the CMX500 NTN one-box tester supports NR‑NTN, NB‑NTN and Direct-to-Cell, allowing users to test NTN technologies at network and device level without multiple instruments. The NTN questionnaire evidence explicitly asks about NTN device chipset/hardware platform, test layer RF/protocol/application, NB‑NTN/NR‑NTN/DTC, Rel. 17/18/19, service-link bands, satellite orbit, gateway integration, throughput, battery lifetime, latency, mobility and handover/beam switching. Sources returned: “R&S CMX500”; “CMX500 NTN one-box tester”; “R&S NTN signaling solutions”; “cmx500_ntn_customer_questionnaire.” |
| 6 | **Multi-radio coexistence and cellular/WLAN combo-chip validation** | **CMX500 for signaling/interworking; CMP180 for production RF** | Semiconductor combo platforms increasingly integrate cellular + Wi‑Fi/Bluetooth/GNSS-like functions. The vault evidence is strongest for cellular + WLAN coexistence/offload, not for all short-range radios. | Returned evidence says CMX500 can test cellular and non-cellular standards in a single setup and supports WLAN signaling/TX measurements including 802.11ax, 802.11be and 802.11bn with 2x2 MIMO. The Wi‑Fi 7 R&D evidence includes coexistence and E2E test capabilities. CMX500 also demonstrates cellular 5G and WLAN traffic offloading/interworking using integrated N3IWF and POLQA voice quality measurement for Voice over WLAN. Sources returned: “R&S CMX500”; “Wi‑Fi 7 R&D and production testing”; “Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi‑Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024.” |
| 7 | **High-volume non-signaling RF production test for wireless semiconductor modules/devices** | **CMP180** | The opportunity is production economics: non-signaling test reduces time, while multi-port/multi-analyzer architecture supports parallelism and MIMO scaling. | Returned evidence says WLAN device production RF measurements are performed in non-signaling mode to save time, and CMP180 is optimized for this purpose. CMP180 supports many cellular and non-cellular technologies including Wi‑Fi 6E, Wi‑Fi 7 and 5G NR FR1 up to 8 GHz, with bandwidths up to 500 MHz. It integrates two analyzers, two generators and two sets of eight RF ports, supports 2x2 MIMO in one box, and can scale with two instruments for 4x4 MIMO. Sources returned: “Wi‑Fi 7 R&D and production testing”; “R&S CMP180.” |

**Bottom line:**  
The strongest semiconductor-facing play is the **Wi‑Fi 7 / next-gen WLAN chipset lifecycle**: CMX500 for R&D signaling and real-world feature validation, CMP180 for production non-signaling RF. The next strongest are **5G NR modem validation**, **RedCap/eRedCap IoT chipsets**, and **NTN/D2C chipsets**, all centered on CMX500 signaling/network-emulation capabilities.

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

R&S NTN signaling solutions › 需求蒐集範圍
來源中的問題涵蓋：

- Service offerings：客戶預計透過 NTN 提供 [[IoT]]、broadband、voice 或其他 applications。
- Test environment：live network environment（包含 satellite gateway）或 simulated environment。
- Deployment timeline：NTN service deployment timeline、key milestones、deadlines。
- Test layer：RF、Protocol、Application Testing。
- Technology：[[NB-NTN]]、[[NR-NTN]]、[[Direct-to-Cell]] / [[DTC]] / [[D2C]]。
- 3GPP release：[[3GPP Rel. 17]]、[[3GPP Rel. 18]]、[[3GPP Rel. 19]] 及其 timeline。
- Device platform：NTN devices 使用的 chipset 或 hardware platform。
- Service link bands：S/L/Ku/Ka-Band。
- Gateway integration：是否把 CMX 連接到 [[satellite gateway]]，在 real live satellite network 測試；若是，需提供 gateway bands。
- Satellite orbit：[[LEO]]、[[MEO]]、[[GEO]]、[[GSO]]。
- Payload type：[[transparent satellite payload]] 或 [[regenerative satellite payload]]。
- DTC operator：LTE-DTC 與 NR-DTC 需要的 satellite operator。
- Network complexity：cellular cells 與 satellite cells 的組合。
- Long-term tests：是否需要 hundreds of satellites，例如 [[LEO]] scenario。
- UE：specific device model 或 generic UE simulator。
- Performance metrics：throughput、battery lifetime、latency 等。
- QoS：不同 traffic type 的 prioritization 或 guaranteed bandwidth。

### Recommendation thesis
Prioritize CMX500 for Wi‑Fi 7 signaling R&D and NTN signaling discovery, and CMP180 for Wi‑Fi 7 production non-signaling RF test, while treating semiconductor-market fit as an unverified inference rather than a proven vault fact [7][20][25][26].
### Recommended first-sell opportunities
CMX500 Wi‑Fi 7 R&D signaling is supported because the source describes CMX500 as a multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester with integrated Wi‑Fi 7 test functionality for testing cellular and non-cellular standards in a single instrument setup [7][21].
CMX500 Wi‑Fi 7 R&D is technically relevant because the source lists signaling-mode RF TX/RX testing, MLO, multiple RF chains, 2x2 MIMO, 6 GHz out-of-band discovery, coexistence, and E2E test capabilities [21].
CMP180 Wi‑Fi 7 production non-signaling is supported because the source describes CMP180 as a production-phase non-signaling RF measurement tester for cellular and non-cellular technologies including Wi‑Fi 6E, Wi‑Fi 7, and 5G NR FR1 up to 8 GHz with bandwidths up to 500 MHz [7].
CMP180 next-generation WLAN production exploration is supported because the source says CMP180 demonstrated a 480 MHz WLAN waveform in loopback mode as a potential waveform candidate for yet-to-be-defined Wi‑Fi 8 / IEEE 802.11bn [7].
CMX500 NTN signaling discovery is supported because the questionnaire covers NB-NTN, NR-NTN, Direct-to-Cell, RF/protocol/application test layers, chipset or hardware platform, satellite orbits, gateway integration, QoS, mobility, handover, beam switching, and constellation deployment in a CMX500 environment [20][24].
RAW evidence only confirms that Rohde & Schwarz points readers to more information on CMX500 for NTN testing and on the R&S CMX500 product page [25][26].
RAW evidence also confirms that the CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant is available from Rohde & Schwarz through various deployment options and was shown at MWC 2025 Barcelona [28].
### Product and option mapping
| Product line | Addressable need | Knowledge-base confirmed option / spec | Why it fits | Evidence | Gap / quote risk |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| R&S CMX500 | Wi‑Fi 7 R&D signaling across cellular and non-cellular operation | Integrated Wi‑Fi 7 test functionality; signaling-mode RF TX/RX; MLO; 2x2 MIMO; 6 GHz out-of-band discovery; coexistence; E2E test capabilities | It supports R&D engineers testing latest-generation cellular and non-cellular standards in a single instrument setup | [7][21] | No supplied RAW passage directly links this to semiconductor customers or chipset validation. |
| R&S CMX500 | NTN signaling discovery for chipset/device-platform programs | Questionnaire scope includes NB-NTN, NR-NTN, DTC/D2C, 3GPP Rel. 17/18/19, RF/protocol/application testing, device chipset or hardware platform, satellite gateway, and CMX500 environment | It creates a structured entry point for customers building NTN devices or platforms | [20][24][25] | The questionnaire is discovery material and does not provide formal CMX500 specifications, hardware configuration, option codes, or ordering information [24]. |
| R&S CMX500 | Test workflow productivity | CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant available through various deployment options | It may help automate or accelerate scripting workflows around CMX500 testing | [28] | No supplied passage connects the AI Scripting Assistant specifically to semiconductor validation, CMX500 options, or measurable test-time savings. |
### Scenario entry recommendations
| Scenario | Recommended combination | Entry point | Unverified items |
|---|---|---|---|
| Wi‑Fi 7 chipset or wireless-device R&D | CMX500 | Lead with single-box Wi‑Fi 7 signaling, RF TX/RX under real-world conditions, MLO, 2x2 MIMO, coexistence, and E2E testing [7][21] | Semiconductor/customer fit is not directly stated in the supplied passages. |
| NTN chipset/platform validation discovery | CMX500 | Lead with the NTN questionnaire topics of chipset/hardware platform, NB-NTN, NR-NTN, DTC/D2C, RF/protocol/application layers, satellite gateway, orbit, mobility, handover, beam switching, and CMX500 environment [20][24] | Formal CMX500 NTN option codes, hardware configuration, and ordering details are not provided in the supplied passages [24]. |
### Inference lines
【推論】CMX500 is the strongest signaling-tester opportunity where semiconductor teams need Wi‑Fi 7 R&D validation, because the evidence supports CMX500 Wi‑Fi 7 signaling R&D capabilities but does not directly name semiconductor buyers [7][21][26].
【推論】CMP180 is the strongest non-signaling production opportunity for Wi‑Fi 7 device or module manufacturing test, because the evidence explicitly positions CMP180 for production-phase non-signaling RF measurement with Wi‑Fi 7 and 5G NR FR1 coverage [7].
【推論】CMX500 NTN is a credible semiconductor-platform discovery opportunity, because the NTN questionnaire asks about chipset or hardware platform and CMX500 environment, while RAW evidence points to CMX500 for NTN testing [20][24][25].

來源中的問題涵蓋：

- Test environment：live network environment（包含 satellite gateway）或 simulated environment。
- Deployment timeline：NTN service deployment timeline、key milestones、deadlines。
- Test layer：RF、Protocol、Application Testing。
- Technology：[[NB-NTN]]、[[NR-NTN]]、[[Direct-to-Cell]] / [[DTC]] / [[D2C]]。
- 3GPP release：[[3GPP Rel. 17]]、[[3GPP Rel. 18]]、[[3GPP Rel. 19]] 及其 timeline。
- Device platform：NTN devices 使用的 chipset 或 hardware platform。
- Service link bands：S/L/Ku/Ka-Band。

- Performance metrics：throughput、battery lifetime、latency 等。
- QoS：不同 traffic type 的 prioritization 或 guaranteed bandwidth。

Regulatory test for wireless devices with cellular technology › 重點摘要
- 來源將 wireless products 的 market access approval testing 分成三類：[[Regulatory Compliance Test]]、[[Telecom Industry Certification Test]]、[[Cellular Network Operator Acceptance Test]]。Regulatory compliance 被描述為各區域法律面 market access 的必要條件；industry certification 例子包含 [[GCF]] / Cellular、[[Bluetooth SIG]]、[[FiRa]] / [[UWB]]、[[Wi-Fi Alliance]]；operator acceptance test 例子包含 AT&T、VzW、T-mobile、CMCC。
- 來源主張 wireless products 需要 [[CE marking]] / [[FCC ID]]；test results 是 technical documentation 的一部分，需在產品投放市場前準備、可提供給 surveillance authorities，並自 placed on the market 起保存 10 years。
- 來源列出 Ericsson Mobility Visualizer Jan 2023 的 mobile subscriptions 表，顯示 2022–2028 的 5G subscriptions 由 1046.006 增至 4974.568；但單位與表格數值口徑未在轉檔文字中完整標示。
- [[CE RED 無線設備法規測試]]被整理成四類 essential requirements：Art 3.1a Health & Safety、Art 3.1b EMC、Art 3.2 Radio Spectrum、Art 3.3 Specific topics。來源列出多個 ETSI EN standards，例如 [[EN 300 328]]、[[EN 301 893]]、[[EN 303 687]]、[[EN 301 908-1]]、[[EN 301 908-13]]、[[EN 301 908-24]]、[[EN 301 908-25]]、[[EN 301 489-52]] 等。
- 對 [[5G NR SAR testing]]，來源指出 5G NR network emulator is required to drive EUT to extreme transmission condition，multi-radio UE 的 average-SAR feature 需要 flexible signaling functions，涵蓋 cellular standards、Wi-Fi 與 Bluetooth；來源將 [[R&S CMW500]] / [[R&S CMX500]] 稱為 SAR / HAC signaling solution。
- 對 Art 3.1b EMC，來源指出 EMC tests 需要 radio enabled 與 radio disabled conditions，因此 5G NR 也需要 signaling solution；mobile phone 仍需要 [[Audio Breakthrough]] test，從 GSM 到 VoLTE / VoNR by 5G。來源提到 [[R&S TS9982 EMS Test System]] 與 [[R&S TS9975 EMI Test System]]。
- 對 Art 3.2 Radio Spectrum，來源指出 5G NR specification 包含 FR1 與 FR2；FR1 test setup stays conducted，FR2 test setup becomes radiated；並把 3GPP test cases、CTIA-OTA test cases、TRP / TRS、RSE 測試連到 [[R&S TS8991]] 與 [[R&S TS8996]]。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › Production：R&S CMP180 non-signaling RF testing
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- WLAN device production phase 中，所有 RF measurements 以 non-signaling mode 執行以節省時間。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 被定位為 optimized for this purpose 的 radio communication tester。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] 支援 many cellular and non-cellular technologies，包括 [[Wi-Fi 6E]]、[[Wi-Fi 7]] 與 [[5G NR FR1]] up to 8 GHz，bandwidths up to 500 MHz。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 將展示 loopback mode 驗證 **480 MHz bandwidth** 的 [[WLAN]] waveform。
- 來源稱 480 MHz WLAN waveform 是 yet-to-be-defined [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 的 potential waveform candidate；這不是正式 Wi‑Fi 8 規格。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] integrated two analyzers, two generators and two sets of eight RF ports，可在 single box 支援 2x2 [[MIMO]] testing。
- 來源稱 two [[R&S CMP180]] instruments can be combined and scaled to support four analyzers and generators for efficient testing of 4x4 [[MIMO]] access points。

R&S CMP180 › Receiver test functions
- RF generator signal is split and forwarded to 8 output ports each。
- every output can be switched off separately。
- collective output level setting for connectors RF 1.1 to RF 1.8 and RF 2.1 to RF 2.8。
- frequency-dependent attenuation（FDA）table for user-specific corrections，分別對 RF 1.1 to RF 1.8 與 RF 2.1 to RF 2.8。

Christian Dobmeier
[[Christian Dobmeier]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 Director of Product Group CMX500；目前本頁只由 [[Gatehouse Satcom and Rohde & Schwarz formalize collaboration to strengthen 5G GEO- and LEO-NTN validation and testing]] 支撐。

CMX500 NTN one-box tester › 相關工具與 package
來源明示或描述下列工具 / package：

- [[Constellation Insight Tool]]：用於 real-time constellation visualization、mobility management、trajectory observation、digital twin of the live sky、automated deployment and handovers、ephemeris data integration 與 complex handover scenarios。
- [[XLAPI]] Python Test Case package：包含 Starlink [[LTE-DTC]] scenarios，例如 LTE attach time / success rates、Event A3 handover、cell reselection 與 RLF recovery。
- [[ScriptAssist]]：AI-powered script generation tool，用於加速 NTN-specific R&D protocol and application testing 以及 instrument automation 的 scripting。
- [[R&S CMX-KS627B]]：[[CMX500_Callbox]] 中列為 NR Signaling Extension Rel-17，用於 NTN slide 的 option 線索。

Constellation Insight Tool › 與 CMX500 NTN testing 的關係
[[Constellation Insight Tool]] 出現在 upgraded [[CMX500 NTN one-box tester]] 的 PR 語境中，補強 [[R&S CMX500]] 對 [[Non-Terrestrial Network]] testing scenarios 的支援。

它與下列概念相關：

- [[5G NTN validation and testing]]
- [[CMX500 NR-NTN configuration]]
- [[NTN signaling customer discovery]]
- [[CMX500 NTN one-box tester]]
- [[Full Satellite Access Network emulation]]
- [[gNB and 5G core network emulation]]

cmx500_ntn_customer_questionnaire › 關鍵實體與概念
- [[R&S NTN signaling solutions]]：來源中的 solution 名稱，針對 [[NTN]] signaling / communication technology 的客戶需求蒐集。
- [[R&S CMX500]]：來源在 deployment 題目中提到 CMX500 environment，也在檔名中出現 cmx500；本來源不可用來補充正式 CMX500 規格。
- [[Tim Seyler]]：來源列為 contact，並標示 Product Manager Mobile Radio Testing。
- [[NTN signaling customer discovery]]：本問卷形成的需求訪談框架，涵蓋 services、live/simulated testing、timeline、test layer、technology、satellite orbit、payload、network complexity、long-term tests、UE、QoS、mobility、handover / beam switching 與 constellation deployment。
- [[NB-NTN]]、[[NR-NTN]]、[[Direct-to-Cell]] / [[DTC]] / [[D2C]]：來源要求客戶指出相關 technology。
- [[3GPP Rel. 17]]、[[3GPP Rel. 18]]、[[3GPP Rel. 19]]：來源要求客戶指出 NB-/NR-NTN 相關 3GPP release 與 timeline。
- [[LEO]]、[[MEO]]、[[GEO]]、[[GSO]]：來源要求客戶說明 NTN services 使用的 satellite orbit。
- [[transparent satellite payload]]、[[regenerative satellite payload]]：來源要求客戶說明 satellite payload 類型。
- [[satellite gateway]]：來源詢問是否將 CMX 連接到 satellite gateway，在真實 live satellite network 中測試，以及 gateway 使用哪些 bands。

R&S NTN signaling solutions › 需求蒐集範圍
來源中的問題涵蓋：

- Service offerings：客戶預計透過 NTN 提供 [[IoT]]、broadband、voice 或其他 applications。
- Test environment：live network environment（包含 satellite gateway）或 simulated environment。
- Deployment timeline：NTN service deployment timeline、key milestones、deadlines。
- Test layer：RF、Protocol、Application Testing。
- Technology：[[NB-NTN]]、[[NR-NTN]]、[[Direct-to-Cell]] / [[DTC]] / [[D2C]]。
- 3GPP release：[[3GPP Rel. 17]]、[[3GPP Rel. 18]]、[[3GPP Rel. 19]] 及其 timeline。
- Device platform：NTN devices 使用的 chipset 或 hardware platform。
- Service link bands：S/L/Ku/Ka-Band。
- Gateway integration：是否把 CMX 連接到 [[satellite gateway]]，在 real live satellite network 測試；若是，需提供 gateway bands。
- Satellite orbit：[[LEO]]、[[MEO]]、[[GEO]]、[[GSO]]。
- Payload type：[[transparent satellite payload]] 或 [[regenerative satellite payload]]。
- DTC operator：LTE-DTC 與 NR-DTC 需要的 satellite operator。
- Network complexity：cellular cells 與 satellite cells 的組合。
- Long-term tests：是否需要 hundreds of satellites，例如 [[LEO]] scenario。
- UE：specific device model 或 generic UE simulator。
- Performance metrics：throughput、battery lifetime、latency 等。
- QoS：不同 traffic type 的 prioritization 或 guaranteed bandwidth。
- Mobility：stationary、pedestrian、vehicular 或其他 UE mobility pattern。
- Handover / beam switching：satellite-UE handovers、beam switching、seamless handovers、optimized beam switching。
- Constellation workflow：是否有興趣 configuring and visualizing constellations，並在 [[R&S CMX500]] environment 中部署其中一部分。

CMX500 Callbox
[[CMX500 Callbox]] 是 [[CMX500_Callbox]] 簡報中對 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 use-case 定位：用一台 callbox 快速建立 DUT 連線，進行 RF、mobility、application、NTN、WLAN / cellular desense、pre-conformance 與 non-signaling R&D 驗證。

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › R&D：R&S CMX500 single-box signaling testing
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- [[R&S CMX500]] 是 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester。
- 來源稱其已新增 integrated [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality。
- 目的在 single instrument setup 中測試 wireless device 在 cellular 與 non-cellular latest-generation standards 下的 operation。
- Wi-Fi 7 R&D 測試需在 signaling mode 與 real-world conditions 下量測 RF TX / RX characteristics。
- [[MLO]] 是 [[Wi-Fi 7]] key feature，因此提供 multiple RF chains 的 test environment 很重要。
- 來源列出的 Wi‑Fi 7-specific tests 包含 2x2 [[MIMO]]、6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery、coexistence 與 E2E test capabilities。

Christian Dobmeier › 來源中的角色
依 [[Gatehouse Satcom and Rohde & Schwarz formalize collaboration to strengthen 5G GEO- and LEO-NTN validation and testing]]，[[Christian Dobmeier]] 以 Director of Product Group CMX500 at [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 身分發言。

其發言重點包含：

- [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 與 [[Gatehouse Satcom]] 合作，以 accelerate validation methodologies for [[5G NTN]] technologies。
- 發言中明示包含 [[GEO]]、[[MEO]] 與 [[LEO]] satellite services。
- 當 satellite sector converges on standardized, [[3GPP]] based solutions 時，software innovators 與 test equipment specialists 的 close collaboration 很重要。
- 此 partnership 不只 strengthens tools and insights for today’s [[5G NTN]] rollout，也 lays a solid foundation for future [[6G NTN testing and validation]]。

- [[R&S CMX500]] radio communication tester has evolved into a versatile, all-in-one platform for NTN testing。
- 來源明示 supported technologies：[[NR-NTN]]、[[NB-NTN]]、[[Direct-to-Cell]]（D2C / DTC）。

- Multi-orbit：[[LEO]]、[[MEO]]、[[GEO]]、[[GSO]]。

passages.text: In the production phase of WLAN devices, all RF measurements are performed in non-signaling mode to save time. Rohde & Schwarz has optimized the [R&S CMP180](https://www.rohde-schwarz.com/us/products/test-and-measurement/wireless-tester-rf-analyzer-generator/cmp180-radio-communication-tester_63493-1081280.html "CMP180") radio communication tester for this purpose. The instrument supports many cellular and non-cellular technologies including Wi-Fi 6E, Wi-Fi 7 and 5G NR FR1 up to 8 GHz in frequency with bandwidths up to 500 MHz. Leveraging the wide bandwidth, the R&S CMP180 will demonstrate at MWC its ability to verify a WLAN waveform with 480 MHz bandwidth in loopback mode, a potential waveform candidate for the yet-to-be-defined Wi-Fi 8 (IEEE 802.11bn) standard. This feature shows that the cost-effective instrument is future-proof for users not only in production, but also in R&D.

passages.text: The CMX500 is a modular, powerful one-box signaling tester enabling comprehensive multi-technology testing. It covers LTE and NR in SA/NSA modes, NR-NTN, NB-NTN, Direct-to-Cell (D2C/DTC) testing and WLAN including Wi‑Fi 7 and Wi‑Fi 8. Consequently, the CMX500 allows R&D engineers of wireless devices to comprehensively test their design’s operation in both cellular and non-cellular standards of the latest generation in a single instrument setup.
